name: sapstack
description: SAP Enterprise Operations Platform — 20 plugins, 16 agents, 18 commands, 328+ T-codes, 6 languages, MCP server, VS Code Extension, country/industry/bridge/exceptions/hooks frameworks
author: BoxLogoDev

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @boxlogodev/sapstack-runtime && npm run build --workspace @boxlogodev/sapstack-mcp
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @boxlogodev/sapstack-runtime && npm run test --workspace @boxlogodev/sapstack-mcp
scripts.test:desktop: bun run --cwd apps/desktop typecheck:shared && bun run --cwd apps/desktop typecheck:electron
